summary: Added App.call_from_thread(callback, *args, **kwargs) in src/textual/app.py. It runs the callback (sync or async) in the app's event loop via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe, blocks the calling thread until it returns, and returns the result. It raises RuntimeError when called from the app's own thread (would deadlock) or when the app is not running; callback exceptions propagate to the caller. The loop and thread ID are recorded in _process_messages, with matching state initialised in __init__. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with four cases. Verification: the shared venv lacks pytest-asyncio, so pytest could not run the async tests (the existing test_call_later.py fails the same way). A standalone script run outside the repo passed all scenarios, and I deleted it. Three pre-existing collection errors remain (missing aiohttp and jinja2, plus tests/cli/test_cli.py). Nothing is committed.
